x: The foreword, the life of the Shaykh, Shāh Naqshband’s homage to him, and the chain by which the Qādiriyya descends.
Foreword

In the Name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. All praise is due to Allah, the Lord of all worlds, and peace and blessings be upon our beloved Prophet Muhammad, his pure family, and noble companions.

This humble offering, Salat al-Kubra of Shaykh Abdal Qadir Jilani, emanates from the luminous legacy of the Ahl al-Bayt. It is with profound respect and devotion that we share this treasured collection as a gift (khidma) from a dedicated group of seekers. Their unwavering commitment to preserving and disseminating this sacred tradition is a testament to their love and reverence for the blessed progeny of the Prophet (PBUH).

Salat al-Kubra (SK) mirrors the esteemed Dalail al-Khayrat (DK) in its depth and sanctity, however, it predates the DK. The DK pays homage to the SK by adopting some of the salawat. Its recitation, when performed daily, weaves a tapestry of divine blessings and spiritual elevation. This practice, embraced with sincerity and consistency, serves as a beacon guiding the heart towards the Divine Presence, fostering a life enveloped in mercy, protection, and inner peace.

May this work inspire hearts, illuminate minds, and draw us ever closer to the infinite mercy of our Creator. We pray that its recitation becomes a source of endless blessings for all who engage with it.

The compilers of this document thank Faqeer Nazim Uwaisi for permission to share with the public to recite the Greatest Prayer in a state of purity and ablution, for until now it was restricted to a smaller circle due to its tajalliat. It represents the pinnacle of salawat from the Ahl al Bayt. We hope the readers will complement their recitals of the Dalilul Khayarat with those of the Salat al Kubra, and partake in the reward by sharing the document with those who will respect and honor it. Peace and blessings be upon our master Muhammad, his family, and companions, eternally.
Amin Patel June 27, 2024 · 21 Dhul Ḥijja 1445
About Shaykh ʿAbd al-Qādir al-Jīlānī

Shaykh Abdal Qadir Jilani قَدَّسَ اللهُ سِرَّهُ, also known as Abdul Qadir Gilani, was born in 1077, in the Persian province of Gilan (modern-day Iran). He is renowned as the founder of the Qadiriyya Sufi order, one of the most influential and widespread Sufi orders in the Islamic world. He followed the Hanbali school of fiqh.

Abdal Qadir Jilani قَدَّسَ اللهُ سِرَّهُ was a descendant of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and was known for his piety and devotion. At the age of eighteen, he traveled to Baghdad, the intellectual and spiritual hub of the Islamic world, to pursue his studies.

In Baghdad, he studied under many prominent scholars and Sufi masters of his time. He excelled in Islamic jurisprudence, theology, and the mystical sciences, eventually becoming a highly respected teacher and preacher. His sermons attracted large audiences, and his teachings emphasized the importance of inner purity, devotion to God, and service to humanity.

Abdal Qadir Jilani قَدَّسَ اللهُ سِرَّهُ is particularly known for his emphasis on the integration of Sharia (Islamic law) with Sufi practices, advocating a balanced approach to spirituality that harmonized the outward and inward aspects of the faith. His spiritual legacy includes numerous writings, such as "Al-Ghunya li-Talibi Tariq al-Haqq" (Sufficient Provision for Seekers of the Path of Truth) and "Futuh al-Ghaib" (Revelations of the Unseen).

He passed away in 1166, in Baghdad, where his tomb remains a significant site for spiritual journeying. His teachings continue to inspire millions of followers around the world, and his order, the Qadiriyya, remains prominent globally. The imams of the Chishtiya order and the Naqshbandia have paid homage to Shaykh Abdal Qadir Jilani قَدَّسَ اللهُ سِرَّهُ amongst others.

The Greatest Prayer

The compilation before you is one of the most profound supplications ever composed: THE SALAAT 'L-KUBRA—The Greatest Prayer Upon the Prophet by Sayyiduna As-Shaikh Abdul Qadir al-Jilani قَدَّسَ اللهُ سِرَّهُ الْعَزِيْزْ وَ نَوَّرَ ضَرِيْهَ وَ نَفَعَنَا الله بِبَرَكَتِهِ آمِيْنْ.

This powerful invocation is revered under the exalted titles of As-Salaat al-Kubra wa’l-Yaaqut al-Humra wa’d-Durrat ‘l-Kudra (The Greatest Prayer, the Red Ruby, and the Green Pearl) and Kanz al-A’zam (The Greatest Treasure). It is esteemed as one of the greatest prayers upon the Prophet ﷺ ever to have been crafted, encapsulating profound spiritual secrets regarding the path to Allah and the gnosis of Him.
May this document serve as a guide and a beacon, illuminating the hearts and spirits of all who seek the Divine Presence through the profound beauty of Salawat.
